Upper comb: left vertical, short straight right-facing upper branch, short straight right-facing middle branch, then curve right at bottom for third branch. Lower comb mirrors this with its right vertical, two straight left-facing branches and curved left-facing bottom return. Preserve gaps between combs and the sinuous spine. No extra fourth branch or bottom bar.
